name: Radio Group
summary: A fieldset, a legend, and native radios sharing one name — which is what makes Tab treat them as a single stop and the arrow keys move between them. No role="radiogroup", and no JavaScript.
demoNote: Tab into any group and press the arrow keys: they move and select in one action, and Tab leaves the whole group as one stop. All of that comes from the shared name attribute — there is no script on this page.

contract.useWhen: One answer out of a few, where the arrows both move and choose.
keyboard: move and select in one step, unlike a checkbox
one stop for the whole group
states: invalid — aria-invalid=true on each input, set only while the error shows
failureModes: no shared name attribute, so they are not a group and the arrows do nothing
role=radiogroup on a fieldset that already is one
a div styled to look like a legend, which is not the name
one option pre-checked with no sensible default, hiding that nothing was chosen
arrows expected to only move focus, the way they would in a toolbar
